scope: T0 KINEMATIC INITIAL CONDITION ONLY; NO TIME EVOLUTION OR GEODYNAMIC FORCE CLAIM

A_GRAPH_CORRELATED_EULER_PRIOR.method: Use boundary-length-weighted plate adjacency; form symmetric normalized adjacency W=D^-1/2 A D^-1/2; graph Laplacian L=I-W; covariance C=(I+L)^-1; independently draw three standard-normal graph fields and transform by the deterministic lower Cholesky factor of C to obtain joint XYZ Euler-vector components.
not_conditioned_on: continental fraction as a speed predictor
A_GRAPH_CORRELATED_EULER_PRIOR.interpretation: Graph smoothness is an explicit model prior on neighboring plate angular-velocity components, not empirical covariance or force transmission.

B_SMOOTH_TANGENTIAL_FIELD_RIGID_FIT.reason: Requires an additional spatial correlation length/spectrum and a field-to-rigid-fit residual rule; no R6 authority binds either, and fitting a smooth field would add assumptions without improving the 12-plate t0 state contract.

C_REDUCED_FORCE_TORQUE.reason: Requires unbound slab/subduction, ridge, mantle-drag, resistance, rheology, and force-geometry states; it would imply physical causal authority that is not present.

prior_parameters.adjacency_weight: sum of positive-length shared-boundary segment lengths for each plate pair
prior_parameters.raw_component_distribution: multivariate normal with zero mean and graph covariance C, independently across XYZ components

global_surface_weighted_rms_speed_cm_per.role: explicit ARCANA synthetic model parameter; broad Earth-like plausibility envelope only
global_surface_weighted_rms_speed_cm_per.not_claimed_as: empirical probability distribution, reconstruction, or measured 210 Ma global speed

prior_parameters.scale_rule: After NNR gauge removal, multiply all Euler vectors by one common positive scalar so the surface-area-weighted RMS speed equals the seeded draw; this fixes only the model family's speed scale and preserves its joint direction/correlation realization.

seed_lineage.derivation: SHA256(root_digest_bytes || 0x00 || generator_version_utf8 || 0x00 || semantic_stream_name_utf8); first 128 digest bits unsigned big-endian
seed_lineage.candidate_sequence: Exactly one deterministic draw; no candidate search, outcome inspection, resampling, or aesthetic selection.

reference_frame.name: SYNTHETIC_AREA_WEIGHTED_LEAST_SQUARES_NO_NET_ROTATION_GAUGE
reference_frame.operation: Fit one common rigid angular velocity minimizing area-weighted squared surface-velocity residual over all represented spherical faces, then subtract it from every plate Euler vector.
reference_frame.distinction: Kinematic gauge only; not mantle-rest, hotspot, torque-balance, or mantle-coupling authority.

hard_validity_constraints_predeclared: exactly 12 unique plate IDs and 30 adjacency pairs bind the parent payload
all generated Euler components and derived speeds are finite
the graph covariance is symmetric positive definite and deterministic
the post-gauge common-spin least-squares residual is <= 1e-12 of pre-gauge norm (or absolute <= 1e-15 rad/year when pre-gauge norm is zero)
the final area-weighted RMS lies within [2,10] cm/year by construction
canonical vector partition and t0 payload hashes remain unchanged

motion_process.first_segment_semantics: INITIAL_EULER_STATE_HELD_CONSTANT_ONLY_AS_A_CONDITIONAL_SEGMENT; not exercised because first interval remains event-guard blocked
motion_process.P03_status: NOT_EXERCISED_INSIDE_FIRST_SEGMENT; segment renewal/change law remains unbound

rift_initial_condition.meaning: Synthetic model initial-condition assumption: no topology-changing rift is active at the instant t=210 Ma.
rift_initial_condition.rift_susceptibility: UNKNOWN; no design-only suture/province label is promoted to weakness

event_guard_policy.eligibility: Tri-state UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN unless all governed eligibility inputs are supported.
event_guard_policy.positive_lead_time: No transferable positive lower bound is established; exact-t0 quiescence alone does not bound the earliest post-t0 event.
event_guard_policy.first_interval: BLOCKED while any relevant event eligibility/trigger/split law is unknown and no strictly positive event-time lower bound exists.

numerical_policy.dt_rule: dt=min(kinematic displacement limit, rotation limit, topology limit, event guard horizon, motion segment validity horizon)
numerical_policy.reason: The displacement/error tolerance, rift event lead time, and motion validity horizon are not governed; no interval is executable.

research_references.use: Earth plate reconstruction speed plausibility and dependence on plate/cratonic/subduction context; not an R6 joint prior.
Rifting is transient and reflects competition among driving, resisting, and weakening processes; no universal transferable initiation delay.
Earth finite-rotation temporal changes and covariance treatment as methodological reference only; not transferred as ARCANA temporal law.
General Earth plate motion order-of-magnitude context; not a calibrated ARCANA distribution.
